datasets.name: kpi_actual
queryLines:
SELECT *
FROM (
  SELECT
    usage_date,
    total_cost_usd,
    LAG(total_cost_usd) OVER (ORDER BY usage_date) AS total_cost_usd_ayer,
    mtd_cost_usd,
    rolling_7d_avg_usd,
    COALESCE(dod_change_pct, 0) * 100 AS dod_change_pct,
    COALESCE(wow_change_pct, 0) * 100 AS wow_change_pct,
    COALESCE(allocation_coverage_ratio, 0) * 100 AS allocation_coverage_pct,
    active_entities,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY usage_date DESC) AS rn
  FROM finops.gold.fct_kpi_daily
) t
WHERE rn = 1

datasets.name: serie_costo
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  total_cost_usd,
  rolling_7d_avg_usd,
  rolling_28d_avg_usd
FROM finops.gold.fct_kpi_daily
WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
ORDER BY usage_date

datasets.name: presupuestos
queryLines:
SELECT budget_name, scope_label, budget_amount_usd, actual_cost_usd, consumed_pct, CONCAT( '
', CAST(ROUND(consumed_pct, 1) AS STRING), '%
' ) AS consumed_pct_bar, projected_total_usd, projected_pct, status, remaining_days, required_daily_cost_usd FROM finops.gold.fct_budget_status QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY budget_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) = 1 ORDER BY consumed_pct DESC

datasets.name: pronostico_org
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date AS fecha,
  total_cost_usd AS costo_usd,
  'Ejecutado' AS serie
FROM finops.gold.fct_kpi_daily
WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 60 DAYS

UNION ALL

SELECT
  forecast_date AS fecha,
  predicted_cost_usd AS costo_usd,
  'Pronosticado' AS serie
FROM finops.gold.fct_cost_forecast
WHERE dimension = 'organizacion'

datasets.name: anomalias
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  dimension,
  dimension_value,
  severity,
  direction,
  actual_cost_usd,
  expected_cost_usd,
  deviation_usd,
  ROUND(pct_change * 100, 1) AS pct_change,
  score
FROM finops.gold.fct_cost_anomaly
WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
  AND severity IN ('high', 'critical')
ORDER BY usage_date DESC, ABS(score) DESC
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: top_entidades
queryLines:
WITH base AS ( SELECT entity_name, entity_type, team, cost_center, environment, proceso, SUM(total_cost_usd) AS total_cost_usd FROM finops.gold.fct_cost_daily WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS GROUP BY entity_name, entity_type, team, cost_center, environment, proceso ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC LIMIT 25 ) SELECT entity_name, entity_type, team, cost_center, environment, proceso, total_cost_usd, CONCAT( '
$', CAST(ROUND(total_cost_usd, 2) AS STRING), '
' ) AS cost_bar FROM base

datasets.name: 298f7fcb
datasets.displayName: Costos acumulados por mes y compute
queryLines:
SELECT
  month_start,
  year_month,
  sku_group,
  compute_family,
  cost_center,
  team,
  environment,
  owner,
  proceso,
  SUM(list_cost_usd)          AS list_cost_usd,
  SUM(discount_amount_usd)    AS discount_amount_usd,
  SUM(effective_cost_usd)     AS effective_cost_usd,
  SUM(estimated_infra_cost_usd) AS estimated_infra_cost_usd,
  SUM(total_cost_usd)         AS total_cost_usd,
  SUM(usage_quantity)         AS total_dbus
FROM finops.gold.agg_cost_monthly
WHERE year_month >= DATE_FORMAT(ADD_MONTHS(CURRENT_DATE(), -12), 'yyyy-MM')
GROUP BY
  month_start, year_month, sku_group, compute_family, cost_center,
  team, environment, owner, proceso
ORDER BY year_month, total_cost_usd DESC

datasets.name: 8e8a6dc4
queryLines:
WITH last_run AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(analysis_date) AS analysis_date
  FROM
    finops.gold.fct_recommendation
)
SELECT
  r.rule_id,
  r.title,
  r.entity_name,
  r.entity_type,
  r.entity_key,
  r.team,
  r.cost_center,
  r.environment,
  r.observed_cost_usd,
  r.estimated_monthly_savings_usd,
  r.confidence,
  r.severity,
  r.recommendation,
  r.estimation_method,
  r.analysis_date
FROM
  finops.gold.fct_recommendation r
    JOIN last_run l
      ON r.analysis_date = l.analysis_date
ORDER BY
  r.estimated_monthly_savings_usd DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: 7c7fd696
queryLines:
SELECT
  usage_date,
  ROUND(COALESCE(serverless_share, 0) * 100, 2) AS serverless_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(all_purpose_share, 0) * 100, 2) AS all_purpose_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(allocation_coverage_ratio, 0) * 100, 2) AS cobertura_pct,
  cost_per_dbu_usd
FROM finops.gold.fct_kpi_daily
WHERE usage_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 90 DAYS
ORDER BY usage_date

datasets.name: 6e474de6
datasets.displayName: Jobs con mayor desperdicio por fallos (30 dias)
queryLines:
SELECT
  COALESCE(job_name, CAST(job_id AS STRING)) AS job,
  team,
  COUNT(*) AS ejecuciones,
  SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fallidas,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) * 100, 1) AS tasa_fallo_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN run_cost_usd ELSE 0 END), 2) AS costo_fallido_usd
FROM finops.gold.fct_job_run_cost
WHERE run_date >= CURRENT_DATE() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS
GROUP BY job, team
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN is_failed THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY costo_fallido_usd DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: 622c8afb
queryLines:
SELECT
  created_at,
  rule_id,
  severity,
  title,
  scope,
  dispatch_status,
  channels,
  delivered
FROM finops.gold.ops_alert_log
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 14 DAYS
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: 4e90ebd0
queryLines:
SELECT
  run_id,
  run_date,
  stage,
  status,
  duration_seconds,
  rows_written,
  error_message
FROM finops.gold.ops_run_log
WHERE run_started_at >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
ORDER BY run_started_at DESC, stage
LIMIT 200

datasets.name: fee0b604
queryLines:
SELECT
  c.usage_date,
  c.compute_family,
  c.entity_key,
  c.cost_center,
  c.team,
  c.environment,
  c.list_cost_usd,
  c.sku_group,
  c.discount_amount_usd,
  c.effective_cost_usd,
  c.estimated_infra_cost_usd,
  c.total_cost_usd,
  c.usage_quantity,
  c.usage_unit,
  c.entity_name,
  c.owner_resolved,
  c.usage_record_count,
  c.workspace_id,
  w.workspace_name,
  ROUND(c.usage_quantity, 2) AS dbus,
  ROUND(c.total_cost_usd, 2) AS costo_usd
FROM finops.gold.fct_cost_daily c
LEFT JOIN finops.gold.dim_workspace w ON c.workspace_id = w.workspace_id
ORDER BY c.usage_date DESC, costo_usd DESC

datasets.name: 18b9249d
queryLines:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT
    usage_date,
    SUM(total_cost_usd) AS costo_dia
  FROM finops.gold.fct_cost_daily
  GROUP BY usage_date
),
cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    usage_date,
    DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date) AS mes,
    DAY(usage_date) AS dia_del_mes,
    SUM(costo_dia) OVER (
      PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', usage_date)
      ORDER BY usage_date
    ) AS costo_acumulado
  FROM daily
)
SELECT
  actual.usage_date,
  actual.dia_del_mes,
  ROUND(actual.costo_acumulado, 2)    AS costo_acumulado_mes_actual,
  ROUND(anterior.costo_acumulado, 2)  AS costo_acumulado_mes_anterior
FROM cumulative actual
LEFT JOIN cumulative anterior
  ON anterior.mes = ADD_MONTHS(actual.mes, -1)
  AND anterior.dia_del_mes = actual.dia_del_mes
ORDER BY actual.usage_date
